actions: You may win with one of the following:
You may win with one of the following:
- Four sets (sequences or triplets) and a pair.
Fu (minipoints) is scored based on the composition of the hand as well as how you win.
- Each triplet is worth 2 fu, 4 if terminal/honors, 4 if closed, 8 if terminal/honors and closed.
- Kans are the same but worth 4x that amount (so 8, 16, or 32 fu).
- Ron with a closed hand adds 10 fu.
- Having a yakuhai pair adds 2 fu. A double wind pair (i.e. both round and seat wind) adds %{double_wind_fu} fu.
- Having a single wait like 12₍₃₎, 1₍₂₎3, or 2₍₂₎ adds 2 fu. Only the final shape matters, so 1234 waiting for a pair of 1 or 4, counts as a single wait since it could be read as 1 234 or 123 4.
- After adding all the fu, round up to the next 10. So 32 becomes 40 fu, but 30 fu stays 30 fu.
- Chiitoitsu (7 pairs) is worth %{fu} fu flat.
- Chiitoitsu (7 pairs) is worth %{ron_fu} fu on ron and %{tsumo_fu} fu on tsumo.
- Kokushi musou (13 orphans) is 30 fu. (Fu does not matter for kokushi hands, but here we say it's 30 fu.)
- If you have a closed hand and won with tsumo (20+2 fu) but not scoring any more fu, it is treated as 20 fu (and awards you the 1 han yaku Pinfu).
- An open hand is minimum 30 fu. You still start at 20 fu, but if you end with 20 fu open, it becomes 30 fu.

If you are waiting for a tile to win, but one of your winning tiles is among your discards (including tiles called by other players), then you are 'in furiten' and cannot win by ron (including chankan). You can still win by tsumo.
By default, Riichi uses the following 136 tiles:
- Four each of the 1 to 9 of circles %{pinzu}
- Four each of the 1 to 9 of bamboo %{souzu}
- Four each of the 1 to 9 of characters %{manzu}
- Four each of the four winds (East, South, West, North) %{winds}
- Four each of the three dragons (White, Green, Red) %{dragons}

In event of an exhaustive draw, players not in tenpai pay players in tenpai. 3000 points total are paid, with the payment split among the non-tenpai players. If all or no players are tenpai, no payment occurs.

Swap-calling is allowed. That is, if you call %{tile} with %{tiles}, you may discard a tile that could have made a set with %{tiles}. (e.g. calling %{aka}, then discarding %{tile}, or calling %{tile}, then discarding %{tile2})
There are no abortive draws enabled.
More than one player may win on the same discard at the same time, triggering separate payments for each winning hand.

(Guangzhou) Aka / ura / ippatsu / rinshan / haitei are each worth 1 shuugi (aka only in a closed hand). Yakuman is worth 10 shuugi on ron and 5 per player on tsumo, doubling per yakuman. All Star (all three aka, calls included) is worth 5 shuugi instead of the individual aka shuugi. Each shuugi is worth 2000 points at the end.

available_mods.name: Change AI Speed
available_mods.desc: Make the AI faster or slower (default 4).

available_mods.name: Four Rows Discards
available_mods.desc: Change the arrangement of the discard pond past the 18th discard to accommodate more discards.

available_mods.name: Open Hands
available_mods.desc: Everyone plays with tiles shown.

available_mods.name: Show Waits
available_mods.desc: Add some UI that shows waits.

available_mods.name: Honba
available_mods.desc: Enables honba.

available_mods.name: Nagashi
available_mods.desc: Enable nagashi mangan. When you discards are all terminals and honors at exhaustive draw, and none of your discards have been called, then you are paid mangan tsumo at draw.

available_mods.name: Uma
available_mods.desc: Enable uma. At the end of the game, points are awarded or deducted based on placement.

available_mods.name: Oka
available_mods.desc: Enable oka. Everyone antes the given amount, and the total is awarded to first place at the end of the game.

available_mods.name: Atozuke Nashi
available_mods.desc: Disallow wins if one of your waiting tiles does not earn yaku.

available_mods.name: Kuikae Nashi
available_mods.desc: Disallow swap-calling.

available_mods.name: Kiriage Mangan
available_mods.desc: 3 han 60 fu and 4 han 30 fu are worth mangan.

available_mods.name: Head Bump
available_mods.desc: Enable head bump. In case of multiple ron, only the person closest in turn order gets the win.

available_mods.name: Double Wind 4 Fu
available_mods.desc: A pair of round+seat winds is worth 4 fu instead of 2 fu.

available_mods.name: Double Round Wind
available_mods.desc: Both East and West are round winds during East Round, and North and South during South Round. Similarly for West and North Rounds.

available_mods.name: Sekinin Barai
available_mods.desc: If you deal the last dragon called for a daisangen hand, or the last wind called for a daisuushii hand, you are responsible for the yakuman payment if they tsumo, or half of the payment if they ron off someone else.

available_mods.name: Suukantsu Pao
available_mods.desc: If you deal the last kan tile called for a suukantsu hand, you are responsible for the yakuman payment if they tsumo, or half the payment if they ron off someone else.

available_mods.name: Rinshan Pao
available_mods.desc: If someone calls kan on your discard and wins off the kan draw, you are responsible for the full payment.

available_mods.name: No Kazoe Yakuman
available_mods.desc: Disable kazoe yakuman. 13+ han is worth sanbaiman.

available_mods.name: No Double Yakuman
available_mods.desc: Disable double yakuman. Yakuman still stacks, but each yaku that typically awards double yakuman only awards one stack of yakuman.

available_mods.name: Wareme
available_mods.desc: In each round, the player whose wall is broken is given the wareme marker. If the wareme player wins, they are paid double the amount of points. If the wareme player has to pay points, they pay double the amount of points. Riichi sticks and honba payments are not affected.

available_mods.name: Aotenjou
available_mods.desc: Removes limit hands. Score grows exponentially with han according to the formula 4 * fu * 2^(2+han). Not recommended with tobi enabled.

available_mods.name: Yakitori
available_mods.desc: If you do not win any hands by the end of the game, you pay each player a penalty.

available_mods.name: Kansai Chiitoitsu
available_mods.desc: Chiitoitsu now allows repeated pairs.

available_mods.name: Minimum Han
available_mods.desc: Minimum han required to win.

available_mods.name: No Riichi Ankan
available_mods.desc: Disallow any concealed kan while in riichi, not just ones that change your waits.

available_mods.name: Yes Riichi Ankan
available_mods.desc: Allow any concealed kan while in riichi, even ones that change your waits.

available_mods.name: No Fifth Tile Tenpai
available_mods.desc: At exhaustive draw, you are not considered tenpai if all four tiles of each wait is in hand: for example, 123456789m1111p. You may still declare riichi with such a hand, however.

available_mods.name: Kokushi Chankan
available_mods.desc: Allow robbing ankans if in tenpai for kokushi musou.

available_mods.name: First Gets Riichi Sticks
available_mods.desc: At the end of the game, all leftover riichi sticks on the table are given to first place. (Otherwise they are lost.)

available_mods.name: Starting Points
available_mods.desc: Number of points each player starts with. You can also set this by writing the following in the Config tab: "initial_score": 100000

available_mods.name: Tonpuu
available_mods.desc: Limit the game to the East round only.

available_mods.name: Tobi
available_mods.desc: Enable busting. Once anyone's points is reduced below zero (or the specified value), the game ends.

available_mods.name: Called Game
available_mods.desc: Enable called game. Once anyone's points reaches above 54999 (or the specified value), the game ends.

available_mods.name: Agarirenchan
available_mods.desc: A round repeats if the dealer wins.

available_mods.name: Tenpairenchan
available_mods.desc: A round repeats if the dealer is tenpai at draw.

available_mods.name: Agariyame
available_mods.desc: All Last doesn't repeat if the dealer is first place and wins.

available_mods.name: Tenpaiyame
available_mods.desc: All Last doesn't repeat if the dealer is in first place and is tenpai at draw.

available_mods.name: Sudden Death
available_mods.desc: Sets the goal points before the game can end. If the game reaches South 4 (or East 4, in the case of tonpuu) and every player is below [goal] points, play continues to the West (South) round until someone surpasses [goal] points, or at the end of West 4 (South 4).

available_mods.name: Suufon Renda
available_mods.desc: Enable 4 wind abortive draw.

available_mods.name: Suucha Riichi
available_mods.desc: Enable 4 riichi abortive draw.

available_mods.name: Suukaikan
available_mods.desc: Enable 4 kan abortive draw.

available_mods.name: Sanchahou
available_mods.desc: Enable triple ron abortive draw.

available_mods.name: Kyuushu Kyuuhai
available_mods.desc: Enable 9 distinct terminal/honor abortive draw.

available_mods.name: Dora
available_mods.desc: Enables dora.

available_mods.name: Ura
available_mods.desc: Enables ura dora.

available_mods.name: Aka
available_mods.desc: Enables aka dora (red fives), worth 1 han each.

available_mods.name: Kandora
available_mods.desc: Enables dora flip on kan.

available_mods.name: Ao
available_mods.desc: Enables ao dora (blue fives), worth 2 han each.

available_mods.name: Kin
available_mods.desc: Enables kin dora (gold fives), worth 3 han each.

available_mods.name: Aka 1
available_mods.desc: Adds aka ones, worth 1 han each.

available_mods.name: Aka 3
available_mods.desc: Adds aka threes, worth 1 han each.

available_mods.name: Aka 7
available_mods.desc: Adds aka sevens, worth 1 han each.

available_mods.name: Aka 9
available_mods.desc: Adds aka nines, worth 1 han each.

available_mods.name: It's All Aka?
available_mods.desc: Changes all standard tiles to aka.

available_mods.name: Shiny Dora
available_mods.desc: Make dora display shiny.

available_mods.name: Manzu
available_mods.desc: Adds a single manzu joker to the game. The manzu joker looks like 萬 and can represent any character tile.

available_mods.name: Pinzu
available_mods.desc: Adds a single pinzu joker to the game. The pinzu joker looks like 筒 and can represent any character tile.

available_mods.name: Souzu
available_mods.desc: Adds a single souzu joker to the game. The souzu joker looks like 索 and can represent any character tile.

available_mods.name: Vietnamese Jokers
available_mods.desc: Adds eight jokers to the game. See the Vietnamese ruleset to learn how they work. Note that this mod adds a honors joker instead of a flower joker.
Adds a copy of the 19 joker, which can be used as any 1 or 9.
Adds a copy of the 37 joker, which can be used as any 3 or 7.
Adds a copy of the 46 joker, which can be used as any 4 or 6.
Adds a copy of the 147 joker, which can be used as any 1, 4, or 7.
Adds a copy of the 258 joker, which can be used as any 2, 5, or 8.
Adds a copy of the 369 joker, which can be used as any 3, 6, or 9.
Adds a copy of the 123 joker, which looks like 小 and can be used as any 1, 2, or 3.
Adds a copy of the 456 joker, which looks like 中 and can be used as any 4, 5, or 6. Don't confuse it with the red dragon!
Adds a copy of the 789 joker, which looks like 大 and can be used as any 7, 8, or 9.

available_mods.name: Odd
available_mods.desc: Adds a copy of the odd joker, which looks like 單 and can be used as any odd number tile.

available_mods.name: Even
available_mods.desc: Adds a copy of the even joker, which looks like 雙 and can be used as any even number tile.

available_mods.name: Five/Honors
available_mods.desc: Adds a copy of the five/honors joker, which looks like 伍番 and can be used as any five or any honor tile.

available_mods.name: Kanchan/Honors
available_mods.desc: Adds a copy of the kanchan/honors joker, which looks like 卡番 and can be used as any honor tile, but can also be used as the middle tile in any sequence.

available_mods.name: Tsumo
available_mods.desc: Enables menzentsumo. "Closed Self-Draw". 1 han if you win by self-draw without having called any tiles (except concealed kan).

available_mods.name: Riichi
available_mods.desc: Enable riichi declarations. When you are tenpai with at least 1000 points (and it is not your last discard), you may declare riichi before discarding. If the discard passes, you automatically bet 1000 and can no longer change your hand. If you win under this condition, you get the riichi yaku (1 han). If you riichi on your first discard (calls invalidate), this is called Double Riichi and worth 2 han.

available_mods.name: Ippatsu
available_mods.desc: Enables ippatsu. "One-shot". 1 han if you win before or during your next draw after riichi. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Chankan
available_mods.desc: Enables chankan. "Robbing a Kan". 1 han if you win off a player adding a drawn tile to an existing pon to form a kan.

available_mods.name: Rinshan
available_mods.desc: Enables rinshan kaihou. "Flower Blooming on the Mountain Range". 1 han if you tsumo on your kan replacement tile.

available_mods.name: Haitei/Houtei
available_mods.desc: Enables haitei ("Under the Sea") and houtei ("Under the River"). 1 han if you win by drawing the last tile (Haitei) or by claiming the last discard (Houtai).

available_mods.name: Pinfu
available_mods.desc: Enables pinfu. "Minimal Fu". 1 han if your hand is closed and only scores base fu (30 for ron and 20 for tsumo).

available_mods.name: Tanyao
available_mods.desc: Enables tanyaochuu. "Cut Honors And Terminals". 1 han if your hand contains no terminals (1,9 tiles) or honor tiles.

available_mods.name: Iipeikou/Ryanpeikou
available_mods.desc: Enables iipeikou ("Identical Sequences") and ryanpeikou ("Twice Identical Sequences"). 1 han if you have the exact same sequence twice, 3 han if you have two of those in your hand.

available_mods.name: Yakuhai
available_mods.desc: Enables yakuhai. "Value Triplets". 1 han for each dragon triplet or kan, 1 han for a wind triplet or kan matching the round wind, and 1 han for a wind triplet or kan matching your seat. If a wind triplet or kan matches both the round wind or seat wind, you score both (2 han).

available_mods.name: Chiitoitsu
available_mods.desc: Enable chiitoitsu. "Seven Pairs". Enables winning with a seven pair hand, which also scores 2 han.

available_mods.name: Chanta/Junchan
available_mods.desc: Enable chantaiyaochuu ("All Contains Honors/Terminals") and junchantaiyaochuu ("All Contains Terminals"). 1 han if every set/pair in your hand contains an honor or terminal, +1 han if your hand is closed (no calls besides ankan). 2 han instead if each set/pair contains a terminal with no honor tiles, again +1 han if your hand is closed.

available_mods.name: Ittsuu
available_mods.desc: Enable ikkitsuukan. "Punch Through in One Go". 1 han if your hand contains 123 456 789 in one suit, +1 han if your hand is closed (no calls besides ankan).

available_mods.name: Sanshoku
available_mods.desc: Enable sanshoku doujun. "Three-Colored Same Sequence". 1 han if your hand contains the same numbered sequence in three suits, +1 han if your hand is closed (no calls besides ankan).

available_mods.name: Sanshoku Doukou
available_mods.desc: Enable sanshoku doukou. "Three-Colored Same Triplet". 1 han if your hand contains the same numbered triplet in three suits, +1 han if your hand is closed (no calls besides ankan).

available_mods.name: Sankantsu
available_mods.desc: Enable sankantsu ("Three Kans"). 2 han if you called three kans.

available_mods.name: Toitoi
available_mods.desc: Enable toitoihou. "All Triplets". 2 han if your hand consists of four triplets and a pair.

available_mods.name: Sanankou/Suuankou
available_mods.desc: Enable sanankou. "Three Concealed Triplets". 2 han if your hand contains three closed triplets. A closed triplet is a triplet hidden in hand, or a triplet formed by self-draw. Also enables the yakuman suuankou ("Four Concealed Triplets") and double yakuman suuankou tanki ("Four Concealed Triplets Single-Wait").

available_mods.name: Shousangen/Daisangen
available_mods.desc: Enable shousangen. "Little Three Dragons". 2 han (on top of yakuhai) if your hand contains two dragon triplets and a pair of the third. Also enables daisangen ("Big Three Dragons"), which is yakuman for having three dragon triplets.

available_mods.name: Honroutou/Chinroutou
available_mods.desc: Enable honroutou. "Mixed Terminals and Honors". 1 han if your hand is composed only of terminals (1,9 tiles) and honor tiles. Also enables chinroutou ("Pure Terminals and Honors") which is yakuman if your hand is composed only of terminals (no honors).

available_mods.name: Honitsu/Chinitsu
available_mods.desc: Enable honitsu. "Mixed One-Color". 2 han if your hand consists of a single suit plus honor tiles, +1 han if your hand is closed (no calls besides ankan). Also enables chinitsu ("Pure One-Color"), which is 5 han if your hand consists of a single suit (no honor tiles), +1 han if your hand is closed.

available_mods.name: Tenhou/Chiihou
available_mods.desc: Enable tenhou and chiihou. "Heavenly/Earthly Win". Yakuman if you win with your first draw as dealer (Tenhou) or as non-dealer (Chiihou). Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Renhou
available_mods.desc: Enable renhou. "Hand of Man". Instant mangan or yakuman if you win off a discard before your first draw. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Tsuuiisou
available_mods.desc: Enable tsuuiisou. "One-Color Characters". Yakuman if your hand is composed only of honor tiles.

available_mods.name: Ryuuiisou
available_mods.desc: Enable ryuuiisou. "Green One-Color". Yakuman if your hand is composed only of 23468 bamboo and/or green dragon.

available_mods.name: Chuurenpoutou
available_mods.desc: Enable chuurenpoutou. "Nine Connected Lanterns". Yakuman if your hand (including winning tile) has no calls and looks like 1112345678999 of any suit, plus one additional tile of that suit. Double yakuman if your hand (no winning tile) contains exactly 1112345678999, which is a nine-sided wait.

available_mods.name: Kokushi Musou
available_mods.desc: Enable kokushi musou. "Peerless Warriors". Yakuman if your hand (including winning tile) contains all 13 terminals and honors, plus an extra one forming a pair. Double yakuman if your hand (no winning tile) contains all 13 terminals and honors, waiting on a 13-sided wait for a pair.

available_mods.name: Shousuushii
available_mods.desc: Enable shousuushii. "Little Four Happiness". Yakuman if your hand contains three wind triplets/kans, with a pair of the fourth. Also enables daisuushii ("Big Four Happiness") which is double yakuman if your hand contains four wind triplets/kans.

available_mods.name: Suukantsu
available_mods.desc: Enable suukantsu ("Four Kans"). 2 han if you called three kans.

available_mods.name: Nippatsu
available_mods.desc: Enables nippatsu. 1 han if you win during the second go-around after riichi ippatsu. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Tsubame Gaeshi
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Swallow Reversal". 1 han if you win off a riichi declaration discard.

available_mods.name: Shiiaru Raotai
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Twelve Tiles Down". 1 han if you win with four calls (and therefore on a single tile wait). Closed kans are permitted.

available_mods.name: Kanburi
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Shoot After Kan". 1 han if you win off the tile discarded by a player who just called kan.

available_mods.name: Honors Chiitoitsu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. 1 han on top of chiitoitsu if three of your pairs are dragons, or if four of your pairs are winds. If you have all seven honor pairs? Double yakuman.

available_mods.name: Uushin Tsuukan
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Five-Heart Straight". 1 han on top of ittsuu if the winning tile is the five needed for ittsuu.

available_mods.name: Ketsupaihou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Missing Tile". 1 han if you have an edge (12, 89) or middle (24, 57) wait on a tile for which three are already publicly visible (so 12333 winning on 3 doesn't count).

available_mods.name: Open Riichi
available_mods.desc: You have the option to declare open riichi, which is worth 2 han but reveals your hand to the table. Open double riichi is 3 han.

available_mods.name: Sanrenkou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Three Consecutive Triplets". 2 han for having three triplets of the same suit in sequence, like 222 333 444.

available_mods.name: Sanshoku Ittsuu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. 1 han for having a three-color straight, like 123m 456p 789s. 2 han if closed.

available_mods.name: Kyandonhou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Twice Mixed Double Sequence". A mixed double sequence is when you have two sequences of the same number in different suits, like 345m 345p. 2 han for having two mixed double sequences.

available_mods.name: Ryandoukou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Twice Double Triplets". A double triplet is when you have two triplets of the same number in different suits, like 333m 333p. 2 han for having two sets of double triplets.

available_mods.name: Shoutate
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Little Mixed Triplets". 2 han for having sanshoku doukou, except one of the triplets is a pair.

available_mods.name: Choupaikou etc.
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. 2 han for having the pattern 111333555 (choupaikou), 111444777 (sujipaikou), or 111555999 (chousankou) in one suit. The pattern does not have to start with 1, but cannot wrap. 1 han if instead, all three triplets are in different suits.

available_mods.name: Suuzuukou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Four Honor Triplets". 2 han for having four honor tile triplets.

available_mods.name: Uumensai
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Five Suits Collected". 2 han if your hand includes all five suits (character, circle, bamboo, wind, dragon).

available_mods.name: Sanpuukou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Three Wind Triplets". 2 han if you have three wind triplets.

available_mods.name: Otakaze Sankou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Three Guest Wind Triplets". 2 han if you have three guest wind triplets. This requires the round wind to match your seat wind.

available_mods.name: Renkaihou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Consecutive Blossom". 2 han if you kan off the rinshan tile and win off of _that_ rinshan tile. Does not stack with rinshan.

available_mods.name: Mondeikou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. If you have 4 aka, 2 han on top of aka. This counts as a yaku.

available_mods.name: Isshoku Sanjun
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Pure Triple Sequences". 2 han if you have three of the exact same sequence in one suit, like 123 123 123. Like iipeikou but three. +1 han if closed. Does not stack with iipeikou (123 123) or sanrenkou (111 222 333).

available_mods.name: Ittsuu Chanta
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. 2 han if you have ittsuu, and (except the 456) the rest of your hand is chanta (or junchan, in which case it's 3 han). +1 han if closed. Does not stack with ittsuu.

available_mods.name: Tanfonhou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Win Without Red". 2 han if your hand contains no red. This means you can have only 248p (2,4,8 circles), 23468s (2,3,4,6,8 bamboo), and any honors except red dragon. 5 han instead if no honor tiles (chintanfon). +1 han if closed.

available_mods.name: Chinpeikou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. 3 han on top of ryanpeikou if your ryanpeikou sequences are all the same numbers (may be different suits), like 112233 112233. No restriction on the pair, so you can have an honor pair (despite 'chin' being in the name).

available_mods.name: Chinchii Toushii
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Golden Rooster Steals Food". 4 han instead of the usual 2 han if you win ketsupaihou by chankan.

available_mods.name: Kinkei Dokuritsu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Golden Rooster Standing Alone". Mangan if you are waiting on 1s (1 bamboo, the bird tile) with four calls. Can be open or closed.

available_mods.name: Touchao Hanchanshue
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Fishing Alone in the Cold River Snow". Mangan if you are waiting on 5z (white dragon) with four calls (open or closed).

available_mods.name: Uupin Kaihou
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Gathering a Plum Blossom from the Roof". Mangan if you win with rinshan on the 5p (5 circles).

available_mods.name: Ryanzou Chankan
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Scratching a Carrying Pole". Mangan if you win with chankan on the 2s (2 bamboo).

available_mods.name: Iipin Mouyue
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Plucking the Moon from the Bottom of the Sea". Mangan if you win with haitei (not houtei) on the 1p (1 circles).

available_mods.name: Chuupin Raoyui
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Catching Fish from the Bottom of the River". Mangan if you win with houtei (not haitei) on the 9p (9 circles).

available_mods.name: Shanron Chonchu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Two Dragons Fighting Over Pearls". Mangan if you have kyandonhou (two mixed double sequences) in manzu and souzu, plus a pinzu pair. For the manzu and souzu suits, your two sequences in that suit should not overlap.

available_mods.name: Chiishin Uushii
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Seven Stars Disconnected". Mangan if you have one of every honor tile, plus 7 of 9 tiles in different suji (e.g. 14m25p369s).

available_mods.name: Maneshi Mangan
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. "Imitation Mangan". If you copy any opponent's first five discards exactly, they will pay mangan if you win, but only if you win less than mangan. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Rentsuu Honitsu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. Mangan if you have honitsu with dragon yakuhai matching the suit: manzu with chun, pinzu with hatsu (not a typo), or souzu with haku (also not a typo).

available_mods.name: Dorahairi Chinroutou Chiitoitsu
available_mods.desc: Local yaku. Mangan if you have chiitoitsu composed of each terminal tile with the seventh pair being dora.

available_mods.name: Paarenchan
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. The eighth consecutive dealer win is worth yakuman. Exhaustive and abortive draws break the streak. After 5 wins, the minimum han required for the dealer becomes 2 han.

available_mods.name: Ishino Uenimo Sannen
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Three Years on a Rock". If you win with double riichi and haitei/houtei, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Toukanhou
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "First Kan Win". If you kan (concealed or from a player) before discarding any tile, and win with rinshan, it's yakuman. Any call from an opponent invalidates this.

available_mods.name: Shiisanpuutaa
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Thirteen Unconnected". If you start with 13 disconnected tiles (with one forming a pair), it's yakuman. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Shiisanuushi
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Thirteen Independent". If you start with 14 disconnected tiles, it's yakuman. Calls invalidate.

available_mods.name: Suurenkou
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Four Consecutive Triplets". If you have four triplets of the same suit of increasing number, like 111 222 333 444, it's yakuman. Pao is applied if the fourth triplet is called.

available_mods.name: Suuchoupaikou
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Four Skipped Tile Triplets". If you have four triplets of the same suit whose numbers step by 2, like 111 333 555 777, it's yakuman. Pao is applied if the fourth triplet is called.

available_mods.name: Shou/Daisharin
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If your hand is closed and your winning hand is 11223344556677 or 33445566778899 in one suit, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Isshoku Yonjun
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Pure Quadruple Sequences". If you have four of the exact same sequence in one suit, like 123m 123m 123m 123m, it's yakuman. Like iipeikou but four. Pao is applied if the fourth sequence is called.

available_mods.name: Hyakuman Goku
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "One Million Stones". If your hand is purely character tiles whose numbers sum up to at least 100, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Kachoufuugetsu
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Flower, Bird, Wind, Moon". If your hand is 555p (5 circles) + 111s (birds) + triplet of round or seat wind + 111p (1 circles), it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Fuukasetsugetsu
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Flower, Bird, Snow, Moon". If your hand is 555p (5 circles) + 555z (white dragon) + triplet of round or seat wind + 111p (1 circles), it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Kouitten
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "A Little Red". Like ryuuiisou, except instead of green dragon, it's red dragon (you must include red dragons).

available_mods.name: Benikujaku
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "Red Peacock". Like ryuuiisou but red bamboo only: you can only have 1579s and red dragon.

available_mods.name: Kokuiisou
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. "All Black". Like ryuuiisou but black: you can only have 248p and winds.

available_mods.name: Ryuuiisourin
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. Like ryuuiisou, except you have a pair of 5s (5 bamboo).

available_mods.name: Kouittenrin
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. Like kouitten, except you have a pair of 5s (5 bamboo).

available_mods.name: Golden Gate Bridge
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If your hand contains 123 345 567 789 all in one suit, it's yakuman. No restrictions on your pair.

available_mods.name: American Civil War
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If you have no calls (not even ankan) and your hand consists of the tiles 1861 in one suit, 1865 in another suit, and you have triplets of north and south winds, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Tohoku Expressway
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If your hand consists of only 246p (2,4,6 circles) and east/north winds, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Tohoku Shinkansen
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If your closed hand consists of an ittsuu and east/north winds, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Blue Tunnel
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If your hand consists of only 248p (2,4,8 circles), green dragon, and one type of wind, it's yakuman.

available_mods.name: Junsei Ryuuiisou
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If you have ryuuiisou without green dragon, it's double yakuman. Doesn't stack with ryuuiisou.

available_mods.name: Chousangen
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If you have kans of all three dragons, it's double yakuman. Doesn't stack with daisangen.

available_mods.name: Chousuushii
available_mods.desc: Local yakuman. If you have kans of all four winds, it's quadruple yakuman. Doesn't stack with daisuushi and suukantsu.

available_mods.name: Shuugi
available_mods.desc: Play with shuugi (poker chips). Each shuugi is worth some number of points each at the end. Win payments include shuugi along with points. On ron, you get shuugi from the discarder; on tsumo you get shuugi from everyone.

available_mods.name: Ippatsu
available_mods.desc: Ippatsu is typically worth one shuugi.

available_mods.name: Ura
available_mods.desc: Each ura dora scores shuugi.

available_mods.name: Yakuman
available_mods.desc: Yakuman is typically worth 10 shuugi on ron and 5 on tsumo.

available_mods.name: Aka
available_mods.desc: Each aka dora scores shuugi.

available_mods.name: Ao
available_mods.desc: Each ao dora scores shuugi.

available_mods.name: Kin
available_mods.desc: Each kin dora scores shuugi.

available_mods.name: Oka
available_mods.desc: Oka applies directly to chips.

available_mods.name: Uma
available_mods.desc: Uma applies directly to chips.

available_mods.name: Toriuchi
available_mods.desc: On ron, each 1s (bird) tile is worth 1 shuugi, unless the discarder's hand contains 7p (pistol) which would shoot the birds dead. That is, unless the winner's hand contains 8s (birdcage) which would protect the birds from gunfire.

available_mods.name: Tobi
available_mods.desc: If a player busts, they pay 1 chip to every player.

available_mods.name: Called Game
available_mods.desc: If a player reaches the called game score, they receive 1 chip from every player.

available_mods.name: Placement-Only Battle
available_mods.desc: Final scores are completely determined by oka and uma, using the final score to determine ranking.

available_mods.name: Arisu
available_mods.desc: After a concealed win, flip tiles on the wall starting from the visible dora indicator, and gain chips for each matching tile. Repeat until you get no match. Not recommended with joker mods, since it will flip tiles forever.

available_mods.name: Cancellable Riichi
available_mods.desc: Riichi declarations happen only after you confirm by discarding a tile.

available_mods.name: Ten
available_mods.desc: Adds 10m, 10p, and 10s. Changes dora accordingly (if dora is enabled). Tanyao now allows nines, and chanta/junchan/honroutou require tens instead. 13 Orphans now requires the ten instead of the nine of each suit. Ittsuu allows 23456789T.

available_mods.name: Star Suit
available_mods.desc: Adds a fourth suit (stars).

available_mods.name: Space Mahjong
available_mods.desc: Sequences can wrap (891, 912). Winds and dragons can make sequences. You can chii from any direction. Chiitoitsu is disabled. Open kokushi is allowed and worth 3 han.

available_mods.name: Galaxy Mahjong
available_mods.desc: Replaces one of each tile with a blue 'galaxy' tile that acts as a wildcard of its number. For example, galaxy 3s can be used as 3m, 3p, or 3s. Galaxy winds are wind wildcards, and galaxy dragons are dragon wildcards.

available_mods.name: Fifth Tile
available_mods.desc: Adds a fifth copy of every standard tile.

available_mods.name: No Honors
available_mods.desc: Removes the honor tiles (winds and dragons) from the game.

available_mods.name: Shiro Pocchi
available_mods.desc: One of the white dragons is shiro pocchi. Shiro pocchi acts a joker tile when drawn while in riichi.

available_mods.name: Golden Chun
available_mods.desc: One of each dragon tile is a special tile. The special white dragon is shiro pocchi, which acts a joker tile when drawn while in riichi. The special green dragon is an aka dora. The special red dragon is the golden chun, which can be used as a five of any suit, and grants 1 han when used as a five. Completing a hand via shiro pocchi while using the golden chun as a five and having the aka green dragon scores yakuman. If playing with shuugi, a golden chun used as a five scores 1 shuugi.

available_mods.name: Blue Dragon
available_mods.desc: Adds the Chinese blue-framed white dragon as a fourth dragon tile (hakuban). Yaku treats it as an honor tile. Shousangen is reduced to 1 han (+2 from dragons) and Daisangen is reduced to 2 han (+3 from dragons). Adds Shousuugen (3 dragons + dragon pair) as yakuman and Daisuugen (4 dragons) as double yakuman.

available_mods.name: Shouhai
available_mods.desc: Reduces tiles in hand from 13 to 12. The goal is to achieve a tenpai hand rather than a winning hand. The idea is that your 13th tile is replaced with an invisible 'joker' tile that can be used to complete any hand.

available_mods.name: Chinitsu
available_mods.desc: Replace the wall with 16 copies of each bamboo tile. Includes 10s if Ten is enabled.

available_mods.name: Washizu
available_mods.desc: Each tile in the wall is transparent and visible to all, except for one copy. Unflipped dora indicators are not visible.

available_mods.name: Yami
available_mods.desc: You may bet 1000 points to discard facedown. Others can bet 2000 points to force it faceup, but you can bet a further 4000 points to keep it facedown.

available_mods.name: Grand Cross
available_mods.desc: You may declare NEWS (one of each wind) as a concealed kan worth 16 fu.

available_mods.name: Nobekan
available_mods.desc: You may kan a sequence of four number tiles.

available_mods.name: Calls Are Forced
available_mods.desc: Forces you to make all available calls, including riichi (if enabled). You still get to choose if multiple calls are available.

available_mods.name: Chombo
available_mods.desc: The tsumo and ron buttons are enabled on every draw and discard. If you make an incorrect win call, your hand is dead and you cannot make a win call for the remainder of the round.

available_mods.name: English Yaku Names
available_mods.desc: Display English yaku names. (e.g. Tanyao -> All Simples)

available_mods.name: Rinshan & Haitei Shuugi
available_mods.desc: Winning off a replacement tile (rinshan) or on the last tile (haitei/houtei) is worth 1 shuugi.

available_mods.name: All Star Shuugi
available_mods.desc: Having all three aka dora in your winning hand (including called tiles) is worth 5 shuugi, replacing the individual aka shuugi.

available_mods.name: Guangzhou Pao Shuugi
available_mods.desc: Pao shuugi settlement: on tsumo the pao player pays 10 shuugi per pao'd yakuman unit plus the normal share of unpao'd units; on ron the discarder pays 10 per unpao'd unit plus 5 per pao'd unit, and each pao player pays 5 per unit they are responsible for.
